statement: Vimala Yoga (the 12th house's lord confined to the 6th, 8th, or 12th house) is traditionally read as carrying loss and expenditure kept contained rather than compounding — traditionally read as a protective, steadying influence despite the houses involved.
editorial_note: Reflects a widely-repeated interpretation found throughout standard Vedic astrological literature, exemplified by (not claimed as a verbatim quotation of) the cited source.
